name: Anbernic RG34XXSP
identify: helperFunctions.sh: cpuinfo CPU part "*0xd03*" (H700) -> reads BASEOS_TARGET from /etc/baseos-release; case "rg34xxsp" -> PLATFORM=AnbernicXX720480

pad.from: derived: same ANBERNIC-keys/event1 pad as the other XX buckets (matrix; no own discovery capture for this bucket)
pad.note: A/B/X/Y, L1/R1, digital L2/R2, SELECT/START, MENU (plus its KEY_GOTO tap pulse), D-pad hat, stick axes and FF rumble, all on one event1 node (also enumerates as js0). Its EV_KEY bitmask also advertises KEY_ESC/KEY_VOLUMEDOWN/KEY_VOLUMEUP, but those three never actually fire on this node (controller-matrix C2 / RG28XX diagnostic capture). On the RG34XX SP under BaseOS 1.4.0 (2026-11-12) KEY_VOLUMEUP/KEY_VOLUMEDOWN do arrive here, unlike the capture above.

vol.note: vendor's own typo for the node name, kept verbatim. KEY_VOLUMEUP 115 / KEY_VOLUMEDOWN 114 measured arriving here (not on event1) on RG34XX SP and RG40XX V by the NextUI port, and identified as the volume node in the RG28XX diagnostic capture (controller-matrix event2 entry; matrix: measured on this model (controller-matrix input_nodes.event2 provenance) for this bucket's own node). On the RG34XX SP under BaseOS 1.4.0 (2026-11-12) nothing fired here; the volume keys came on event1 ANBERNIC-keys.

power.from: derived: same axp2202-pek/event0 PMIC node as the other XX buckets (matrix; no own discovery capture for this bucket)

lid-sensor.from: cfg (LID_STATUS_PATH, LID_CLOSED_VALUE in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg); matrix (lid_watchdog_v2.sh runs only on *sp BASEOS_TARGETs)
lid-sensor.note: sysfs poll, not an evdev switch; LID_CLOSED_VALUE=0

VOL_UP.note: on the RG34XX SP under BaseOS 1.4.0 the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys and nothing on dierct-keys-polled (2026-11-12); the controller matrix (C2) and the NextUI port saw it on dierct-keys-polled

VOL_DOWN.note: on the RG34XX SP under BaseOS 1.4.0 the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys and nothing on dierct-keys-polled (2026-11-12); the controller matrix (C2) and the NextUI port saw it on dierct-keys-polled

absent.HOME: cfg B_HOME="DOESNT_EXIST"; MENU is spruce's home key on this line (matrix)
absent.FN_SWITCH: no latching Fn switch on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_LEFT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_RIGHT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)

notes: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME is computed at runtime; rg34xxsp is NOT one of the named arms, so it falls to the default arm: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME="Anbernic RG34XXSP" (upper-cased BASEOS_TARGET, no space) -- note the mismatch against this file's model name "RG34XX SP" (with a space).

VOL_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/POWER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/CONTROLLER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH are exported in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg (event0/event2/event1) but nothing in the h700 tree reads them -- dead variables, not evidence for any control's source (grep of spruce/scripts at spruce_ref 0dccf5276b).

This bucket now covers exactly one model (rg34xxsp); rg34xx and rgsp, which the 2026-09-06 controller-matrix.json/h700-baseos-deep-dive.md still group into AnbernicXX720480, were moved to their own AnbernicXX720480NoStick platform by the current helperFunctions.sh (spruce_ref 0dccf5276b). The old C11 finding ("no DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS arm for rg34xxsp") looks resolved at this ref: AnbernicXX720480.cfg explicitly exports XX_PAD_LAYOUT="2stick" before sourcing AnbernicXXCommon.cfg, which arms DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=2 from that -- re-verify on hardware before relying on this being fixed everywhere.

No discovery capture exists for this bucket in the lab captures; pad/power node facts are derived by parity with the rest of the XX line (matrix), except VOL-on-event2, which controller-matrix states was itself measured on this exact model (RG34XX SP) by the NextUI port.
models are spruce's own SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME values (AnbernicXXCommon.cfg); Button Reader matches the unit's name against them
